baselineRegression.method: Identical final component tests against an isolated turn-start LegalHub copy; other dependencies use current working tree. Fourteen parameterized failures do not mean fourteen independent bugs.

diffCheck: passed with repository CRLF whitespace settings
changes: Four workspace request paths reuse useLegalDocument and a shared tool-result/archive operation; removed separate busy enums, completion strings and duplicated catch/finally logic.
Case identity changes reset workspace request, draft and selected material state; list search stays in the parent scope.
Personal updates/material appends reuse existing legalCaseStore functions so notice extraction no longer overwrites just-saved fields with a stale UI snapshot.
Notice preprocessing awaits field and source-material persistence; errors or case changes prevent the next tool call.
Organization tool results retain backend receipt-confirmed case archives without duplicate material POSTs. Personal results retain local case storage.
Workspace displays actual tool output (including authorized browser handoff) instead of unconditional fixed completion text.
Text/date input templates and three create-dialog fields share CaseField; the obsolete direct-call source-string assertion was removed in favor of actual component/API assertions.
preserved: Tool endpoints, organization/case IDs, legal tool permission enforcement and backend persistence implementations.
Notice confirmedForKb=false, includeExtractedText=true, extractedTextLimit=8000, message and notice text.
Delivery content limit=24000, includeDocx=true, includePdf=false; reasoning writeFiles=true; engagement evidence and profile inputs.
Existing individual operation groups: notice and document actions use separate locks, with all document buttons disabled while a document action is active.
Personal storage schema and real user data untouched.
limitations: Mocked component transport and synthetic case records, plus isolated backend HTTP/database regressions. No native-client acceptance, screenshot comparison or real-model invocation.
No full-suite rerun or backend rebuild for this frontend-only batch.
Frontend cancellation cannot roll back backend writes. A field save already sent remains owned by the parent hub; the cancelled workspace blocks subsequent material/tool steps.
Same-organization rapid optimistic field writes still need ordering and rollback work; this change confirms notice steps but does not make the whole case write transaction atomic.
Legacy personal storage account isolation, remaining material consumers that ignore persistence results, and cross-entry model-endpoint persistence remain open.
No commit, push or client restart.
